placements.title: Automated Ingestion and Commit Pipeline
placements.frame: How does the system ingest, process, and persist memory artifacts through pipeline stages?

placements.title: Automated Resolution of Submission Identifiers and File Commits
placements.frame: How does the pipeline ensure reliable identifier assignment and successful file commits when explicit identifiers are absent?
placements.why: The expressions establish the normative requirement that submissions lacking an explicit id field must produce a slug via LLM generation or deterministic fallback and commit successfully.
